name: Phase 0 — Project preparation
exitCriteria: Requirements, inventory, architecture hypothesis and risk register reviewed
Critical research sources recorded

name: Phase 1 — Feasibility verification
exitCriteria: Commander/Dash coexistence measured
HELIX simultaneous mixing and independent mute demonstrated
Vehicle power path verified from applicable service information

name: Phase 2 — Component selection and procurement
exitCriteria: BOM compatibility verified
Supplier and VAT-inclusive cost checked
Human purchase decisions recorded

name: Phase 3 — Bench prototype
exitCriteria: Simulated telemetry drives deterministic audio
48 kHz optical audio verified
Underrun and stale-data fail-silent tests pass

name: Phase 4 — Vehicle preparation
exitCriteria: Speaker work and wiring documented by qualified installer
Power and thermal installation reviewed

name: Phase 5 — DSP base configuration
exitCriteria: Original preset backed up
Speaker protection and routing measured and reviewed

name: Phase 6 — System integration
exitCriteria: Live read-only telemetry drives Pi
Digital engine contribution coexists with original audio

name: Phase 7 — Acoustic calibration
exitCriteria: Measured phase, timing, response and levels archived

name: Phase 8 — Acceptance testing
exitCriteria: Latency, failure behavior, coexistence, reliability and safe shutdown meet documented criteria

name: Phase 9 — Maintenance
exitCriteria: Recovery, update, backup and periodic inspection procedures established
